::: {#inputDiv}

```{ojs}
// Import classes
import { InputGroup, SuperParserFetcher } from "./widgets.js"

// Instantiate widgets
inputWidget = new InputGroup(html)
viewof input = inputWidget.element

displayWidget = new SuperParserFetcher(html)
viewof display = displayWidget.element

// Reactive wiring: this cell re-runs whenever inputWidget.value changes
displayWidget.update(inputWidget.value)

```
